description: Department of Census and Statistics - National Price Index September 2022
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for September 2022 as computed by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any specialized categories (4-9) as it is purely statistical information publication rather than land, legal, commercial, electoral, public service, or judicial matters. This falls under general administrative/statistical announcements, making it Miscellaneous.
